claims.statement: B12's local adjacent two-affine-coset theorem, joining-column rank lemma, and Hadamard collision refund are correct at their stated one-node scope with sharp constant 8 ln(2).

Pathwise coordinate nonreuse does not imply sum_v w_v I(d_v)<=I(b), and the submitted B12 hierarchy corollary is false under its literal quantifiers; a two-level free-coordinate cylinder extension is an exact counterexample.
